text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING — unusual auth-probe detected against idp-forwarder. honeytoken ht-7f3 triggered across multiple tenants; 401 spike + repeated svc-account attempts. alert: https://internal/alerts/1785678901

olivia (oncall): ack — i'm taking it. starting on-call bridge and escalation.

maria (sre): pulling logs from idp-forwarder now. initial tail looks like repeated replay attempts from a small set of IPs. snippet below.

```
2026-03-17T12:34:22Z idp-forwarder ERROR auth_fail svc=svc-idp-forwarder tenant=acme honey=ht-7f3 src=34.82.11.9
2026-03-17T12:34:24Z idp-forwarder WARN token_replay svc=svc-idp-forwarder tenant=beta src=34.82.11.9
2026-03-17T12:34:29Z idp-forwarder ERROR auth_fail svc=svc-idp-forwarder tenant=acme honey=ht-7f3 src=18.204.12.44
```

raj (sec): thanks. looks like a coordinated probing campaign — srcs cluster in 34.82.11.0/24 and 18.204.12.0/24. can we isolate idp-forwarder ingress and temporarily block those ranges? also check S3 and indexer logs for honeytoken accesses.

ops-jamie: applying temporary WAF deny for 34.82.11.0/24 and 18.204.12.0/24. running `./scripts/waf_block.sh 34.82.11.0/24 18.204.12.0/24` now. will confirm when rules are active.

ben (eng): preparing key rotation for svc-idp-forwarder. will set env flag and trigger rolling restart. patch command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/idp-forwarder -n prod --timeout=5m`.

maria (sre): starting rolling restart, will tail pod restarts and health.

olivia (oncall): also routing reads to idp-forwarder-readonly to reduce blast radius, and applying a short-lived deny on stateful operations.

raj (sec): recommend immediate service key rotation + token revocation. proposed runbook: 1) rotate KMS key for idp-forwarder 2) generate new service creds 3) revoke all live tokens for the service 4) audit downstream secrets and refresh. any objections?

maria (sre): no objections — executing rotation now. command: `./ops/rotate_service_key --service idp-forwarder --kms-alias alias/idp-rot` . will post job id.

incident-bot: rotation job queued (job-9876). monitor: https://internal/jobs/job-9876

legal: tagging in case customer data exposure is confirmed. do we have signs of exfil or object downloads?

raj (sec): quick scan of outbound transfers shows no large S3 GETs correlated with honeytoken hits. honeytoken acted as detector only. running deeper forensic scan across log retention window.

ben (eng): rotation complete on 3/3 pods, restarted. ran `authctl revoke --service idp-forwarder --all` to invalidate tokens. posting status: keys rotated, tokens revoked.

maria (sre): WAF rules active, rotation complete, tokens revoked. auth-401 rate declining toward baseline. continuing to monitor metrics and logs.

olivia (oncall): handing follow-up to raj + maria for forensic deep-dive and postmortem. i'm off-call in 30m, but will check updates. please prepare timeline and impact notes.

raj (sec): will continue scan and update within 2 hours. preparing a draft customer advisory in parallel in case further evidence appears.

maria (sre): collecting logs and timeline for the postmortem. artifacts going to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1785678901 . will include commands run, job ids, and rotation proof.

olivia (oncall): :thumbsup: excellent coordination. closing active pager for now; keeping this thread open for updates and the postmortem.
